```{r}
library("tidytuesdayR")
library("tidyverse")
library("dplyr")
library("ggplot2")

tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2025-09-02')
```


```{r}
id_data <- tuesdata$frogID_data
frog_names <- tuesdata$frog_names
class(frog_names)
# class(id_data)
frog_names$scientificName[frog_names$scientificName == "Heleioporus australiacus australiacus"] <- "Heleioporus australiacus"

frog_data <- left_join(
  id_data,
  frog_names,
  by = "scientificName",
  relationship = "many-to-many"
)
```


```{r}
sum(is.na(frog_data$commonName))
# sapply(frog_data, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
```
